title: Fix Evolution draft metadata command carrier rejection
summary: Repaired BFF EvolutionProgramAction command carrier normalization and adapter payload forwarding for already-supported draft metadata actions (create_constraint, create_fitness_formula, create_mutation_rule) while enforcing fail-closed validation on unknown or conflicting action carriers and preserving principal role/tenant isolation.

root_cause.observed_error: HTTP 422 VALIDATION_FAILED: Unknown evolution program action: createconstraint
root_cause.cause: services/control-plane/bff/command_adapters/contracts.py (_EVOLUTION_ACTION_ALIASES) omitted the already-implemented Evolution program draft metadata actions (create_constraint, create_fitness_formula, create_mutation_rule) supported by services/evolution/program_service.py, causing canonicalize_wrapped_payload to strip underscores and reject createconstraint with 422 before reaching EvolutionCommandAdapter.

scoped_changes.description: Added create_constraint, create_fitness_formula, and create_mutation_rule (and normalized aliases) to _EVOLUTION_ACTION_ALIASES; updated canonicalize_wrapped_payload and normalize_b5_command_payload to validate all present action carriers (command, action, params, and params.payload), fail closed with 422 on unknown or conflicting action carriers, and normalize consistent carriers.

Added _DRAFT_METADATA_PROGRAM_ACTIONS support in EvolutionCommandAdapter, rejected conflicting action carriers across action_id/params/payload with 422, forwarded draft metadata fields for create_constraint/create_fitness_formula/create_mutation_rule, and enforced verified principal role checks in _program_actor_role (rejecting viewer-only principals and conflicting actor_role claims with 403).

Added E2E regression tests reproducing the exact observed UI create_constraint payload (plus create_fitness_formula and create_mutation_rule) through BFF /bff/v1/commands admission and real ProgramService/create_program_router, verifying single persistence on draft program, non-duplicate same-key replay, 409 divergent replay, 422 unknown/conflicting carrier rejection, 401 noauth, 403 viewer role, and 403/404 tenant mismatch isolation.
Added contract tests verifying create_constraint, create_fitness_formula, and create_mutation_rule alias normalization, unconfigured owner fail-closed 422 behavior, and conflicting carrier rejection.

Added owner router test proving create_constraint, create_fitness_formula, and create_mutation_rule persist once on a draft program without altering draft lifecycle status, replay idempotently without duplication, and reject divergent same-key replay with 409.
